FLYBRAIN.Ready: Fly Brain: left toolbar brain icon opens the panel. Select a token, then click Fly / Food / Threat.
FLYBRAIN.GmOnly: Fly Brain commands are GM-only in this version.
FLYBRAIN.OneFly: Only one fly token per scene. The previous fly flag was cleared.
FLYBRAIN.SelectToken: Select one or more tokens first.
FLYBRAIN.WorkerFail: Could not start the Fly Brain worker on this client.
FLYBRAIN.Disclaimer: This is a simplified leaky-integrate-and-fire model on published connectome wiring. It is not a living fly. Motor actions are house-ruled from a few identified cells.
FLYBRAIN.Hint.NeedFly: Select a token and click Fly. Art swaps to the fly PNG; click again to restore the original.
FLYBRAIN.Brain3d.Hint: Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom
FLYBRAIN.Setting.AutonomousHint: When on, the GM client steps the fly token on the grid from motor readout (food / loom / walk).
FLYBRAIN.Setting.OverlayHint: Client setting. GM-only point cloud inset beside the fly token.
FLYBRAIN.Setting.OverlayModeHint: inset follows the fly token. hud keeps meters in the panel only.
FLYBRAIN.Setting.OverlayFpsHint: Cap for uploading the activity buffer. 20 is the default.
FLYBRAIN.Setting.LodZoomHint: Below this canvas zoom, draw region blobs instead of the full point cloud.
FLYBRAIN.Setting.SimMsHint: How much model time the worker advances each table tick.
FLYBRAIN.Setting.ApiKeyHint: Client-only OpenAI-compatible key (OpenAI, OpenRouter, etc.). Used to narrate the fly. Never chooses movement. Also editable in the Fly Brain panel.
FLYBRAIN.Setting.ApiBaseHint: OpenAI-compatible base, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
FLYBRAIN.Talk.Title: Talk to the fly
FLYBRAIN.Talk.Hint: Type here (sugar, loom, walk, stop…). Optional API key makes it answer in flavor text. It never picks the grid step.
FLYBRAIN.Talk.Placeholder: hey fly, sugar — or a looming shadow
FLYBRAIN.Talk.KeyOn: Key saved on this client. Send a line to hear a narrated reply.
FLYBRAIN.Talk.KeyOff: No key yet — lexicon still pokes sugar/loom/walk. Save a key to get spoken replies.
FLYBRAIN.Talk.KeySaved: Speak API settings saved on this client.
FLYBRAIN.Talk.ApiError: API call failed; check key, base URL, and model. Lexicon poke still ran if a keyword matched.
FLYBRAIN.Talk.Sugar: Sugar GRNs lit. Feed readout climbing. The token is not a living fly.
FLYBRAIN.Talk.Loom: Loom cells driven. Escape readout high — it should dash on the grid if walking is on.
FLYBRAIN.Talk.Walk: Forward readout up. Stepping along facing / toward food.
FLYBRAIN.Talk.Idle: No lexicon hit in "{text}". Try: sugar, loom, walk, stop.
